# normfix

> normfix safely formats 42 School C projects and explains the edits it cannot
> prove. It changes only what it can prove is safe, keeps the official
> Norminette as the compatibility authority, and reports everything else
> instead of guessing.

Every write goes through one auditable transaction with external backups and an
undo that fails closed. A run can never leave a file with more official
diagnostics than it started with.

## For agents

Every page below is also published as plain text at its own address plus
`.txt`, so one page's instructions can be fetched without parsing the site:
`https://normfix.vercel.app/docs/guide/ai-agents.txt`.


- [AI agent guide](https://normfix.vercel.app/docs/guide/ai-agents): how to run
  normfix without a person watching, and what it will refuse to do.
- [JSON report schema](https://normfix.vercel.app/docs/reference/reporting):
  branch on `schema_version`; the human output is free to change, the JSON is
  not.
- [Safety and recovery](https://normfix.vercel.app/docs/reference/safety):
  protected scopes, capability grants, backups, and rollback.
- [Exit codes and flags](https://normfix.vercel.app/docs/reference/flags): what
  each flag does, with an example.

## Documentation

- [Why normfix](https://normfix.vercel.app/docs/why): what problem it solves
  and what it deliberately does not do.
- [Getting started](https://normfix.vercel.app/docs/guide/getting-started):
  install, verify, and make a first run that writes nothing.
- [Commands](https://normfix.vercel.app/docs/commands/): one page per
  subcommand, with real output.
- [Compatibility policy](https://normfix.vercel.app/docs/COMPATIBILITY): what
  the version number covers, and what it does not.
- [Browser playground](https://normfix.vercel.app/): the same formatter running
  in a tab, with no upload and no account.

## Source

- [Official repository](https://github.com/viniciusnevescosta/normfix)
- [Official Norminette](https://github.com/42school/norminette): the checker
  normfix defers to, maintained by 42.

## Optional

- [Architecture record](https://normfix.vercel.app/docs/ARCHITECTURE): what each
  crate owns and why the boundaries exist.

A read-only check for an agent:

```sh
normfix check --format json
```

Do not run formatting or destructive flags without explicit permission to
write. `--unsafe`, `--remove-unused`, and `--remove-unexpected` each require a
capability grant, and outside an interactive terminal they additionally require
`--force`.
